data.name: DisplayName
data.value: Network disk (iSCSI / NVMe-TCP)

data.name: Description
data.value: A disk on the network (e.g. an iSCSI LUN of a NAS). BorgStudio logs in before each use and logs out afterwards; logging in needs administrator rights once to set up.

data.name: ProtocolLabel
data.value: Protocol

data.name: ProtocolIscsi
data.value: iSCSI

data.name: ProtocolNvme
data.value: NVMe over TCP (Linux only)

data.name: PortalLabel
data.value: Portal

data.name: PortalHint
data.value: Host name or IP address of the target, optionally with port (iSCSI 3260, NVMe/TCP 4420), e.g. nas.local:3260.

data.name: PortalInvalid
data.value: Please enter the portal as host or host:port.

data.name: TargetLabel
data.value: Target name

data.name: TargetHint
data.value: The IQN (iSCSI, e.g. iqn.2000-01.com.synology:nas.backup) or NQN (NVMe).

data.name: TargetInvalid
data.value: The target name may only contain letters, digits, dots, colons and hyphens.

data.name: ChapUserLabel
data.value: CHAP user

data.name: ChapUserHint
data.value: Only if the target requires CHAP (iSCSI).

data.name: ChapUserInvalid
data.value: The CHAP user may only contain letters, digits and . _ @ -.

data.name: ChapOnlyIscsi
data.value: CHAP is only supported for iSCSI.

data.name: ChapSecretLabel
data.value: CHAP secret

data.name: FolderLabel
data.value: Repository folder on the disk

data.name: FolderHint
data.value: Relative to the disk's volume, e.g. borg/laptop. The volume's drive letter or mount point does not matter.

data.name: FolderInvalid
data.value: Please enter the folder relative to the volume (without .. ).

data.name: UnsupportedMac
data.value: macOS has no built-in iSCSI or NVMe/TCP initiator – network disks are not supported there.

data.name: UnsupportedNvmeWindows
data.value: Windows has no built-in NVMe/TCP initiator – please use iSCSI.

data.name: NotSetUp
data.value: Logging in to the network disk is not set up – open the repository in the editor and save it (asks for administrator rights once).

data.name: RepositoryNotFound
data.value: The network disk was logged in to, but the repository folder {0} did not appear on it.

data.name: SetupFailed
data.value: Setting up the network disk failed.

data.name: SetupFailedBecause
data.value: Setting up the network disk failed: {0}

data.name: SetupDeclined
data.value: Administrator rights were not given – nothing was set up.

data.name: DisconnectFailed
data.value: Logging out of {0} did not work: {1}

data.name: ConnectFailed
data.value: Logging in to the network disk failed: {0}

data.name: PkexecMissing
data.value: pkexec is missing – it asks for administrator rights (package polkit).
